Aranea Scinencia.



A grey spider found in Kentucky on old walls. Does not spin a web. N. O.
        Arachnida. Tincture.



Clinical. ─   Debility. Eyes, affections of.
        Headache.



Characteristics. ─     Aran.
        scin  . has been proved in 1st and 2nd dilutions. One remarkable symptom noticed
        was: "Constant twitching of under eyelids," which brings this spider into line
        with the choreic   Mygale  . Eyes inflamed, weak, watery,
        lids swollen. Rather profuse flow of saliva; sweet taste in mouth. Much dull, stupid
        headache of considerable intensity, especially in postero-superior part of head; unable to
        rest for it; could not collect thoughts with it. Felt as if he had been drinking.
        Sleepiness. All symptoms   <   in warm room.



Relations. ─     Compare:
        Spiders generally. Agar.; Carb. v. (  <   warm room, also
        Puls., Apis, Sul., &c.).
